name: auth.ts
summary: Central authentication and authorization module for all Edge Functions. Extracts JWTs, resolves user roles from profiles and user_roles, enforces role hierarchy, and provides withAuth wrapper for request-level auth. Supports hospital-scoped access control and global admin bypass.

name: errors.ts
summary: Comprehensive domain error hierarchy for SETURA. Defines 18 error classes extending SeturError base class, covering auth, booking, queue, idempotency, rate limiting, and infrastructure failures. No dependencies — pure domain error definitions.

name: rate_limit.ts
summary: Booking attempt rate limiting and blocklist checking. Enforces per-phone and per-IP rate limit windows, checks blocked_numbers table, and logs all attempts. Used by create-booking to prevent abuse.

name: response.ts
summary: Standardized API response builders for all Edge Functions. Provides success, created, error, and typed error response helpers with consistent JSON envelope (success flag, correlationId, timestamp). Injects CORS headers on all responses.

name: validation.ts
summary: Request validation helpers: Zod schemas for common types (UUID, phone, date, gender, blood group, booking source) and request body parsing with field-level error aggregation.

name: reporting.ts
summary: Report data transformation utilities for CSV and PDF-ready export formats. Flattens nested report objects to dot-notation keys, escapes CSV values, and formats data for PDF generation.

name: setup_env.ts
summary: Test environment setup utility. Configures test environment variables (CORS origins, Supabase URLs/keys) for integration and unit test execution.

name: alert-center/index.ts
summary: Edge Function for alert center operations: acknowledge, resolve, assign, and escalate alerts. Supports both human (receptionist/admin) and automated (queue/SLA) alert sources.

name: carry-forward-tokens/index.ts
summary: Edge Function for carry-forward token operations. Handles moving unused tokens from one queue session to another, typically used at session boundaries or end-of-day.

name: command-center/index.ts
summary: Admin command center Edge Function. Handles broadcast operations, queue session broadcasts, and alert escalation. Integrates with the broadcast subsystem for real-time WhatsApp notifications.

name: compute-sla/index.ts
summary: SLA computation Edge Function. Calculates service level metrics (wait time, consultation time, turnaround) per doctor and queue. Supports daily and weekly rollups.

name: create-booking/index.ts
summary: Core booking creation Edge Function. Orchestrates the full booking workflow: auth, phone normalization, rate limit check, idempotency, hospital/doctor availability, and RPC calls to the database booking logic.

name: enterprise-reports/index.ts
summary: Enterprise report generation Edge Function. Supports multi-hospital reporting, date-range filters, CSV and PDF export formats via the reporting module.

name: executive-analytics/index.ts
summary: Executive dashboard analytics Edge Function. Aggregates high-level KPIs (bookings, revenue, queue health) across the hospital for executive and admin consumption.

name: financial-command-center/index.ts
summary: Financial operations command center. Provides aggregated financial views, collection summaries, and settlement status for hospital finance teams.

name: queue-control/index.ts
summary: Queue control operations Edge Function. Wraps queue_runtime functions for pause, resume, open/close sessions, call/skip/restore tokens, mark absent, insert emergency, and doctor delay notifications.

name: refresh-rollups/index.ts
summary: Refreshes pre-computed analytics rollup tables. Triggered by cron or manually. Recomputes daily/weekly/monthly aggregations for dashboard performance.

name: settlement-engine/index.ts
summary: Payment settlement processing Edge Function. Handles end-of-day settlement computation,razorpay settlement reconciliation, and generates collection summaries per hospital.

name: errors.test.ts
summary: Unit tests for the SeturError class hierarchy. Covers base class construction, serialization, and all 18 domain error subclasses.

name: response.test.ts
summary: Unit tests for API response builders. Covers successResponse, createdResponse, errorResponse, fromSeturError, rateLimitResponse, and handleErrorResponse with various input scenarios.

name: validation.test.ts
summary: Unit tests for validation schemas and parseBody. Covers UUID, phone normalization, date validation, advance booking date limits, and gender/blood group enums.

name: cors.ts
summary: CORS header builder and handler for Edge Functions, validates request origins against allowed list.

name: db.ts
summary: Provides Supabase client factory functions: service-role client, anon client, and auth client, plus RPC helper and error assertion.

name: env.ts
summary: Environment variable access layer with typed getters: requireEnv, optionalEnv, requireUrlEnv, optionalIntEnv, optionalBooleanEnv. Exports the Env namespace with all configured variables.

name: idempotency.ts
summary: Idempotency key system for preventing duplicate mutations. Provides key extraction, request hashing, claiming/completing/failing keys, and a withIdempotency wrapper for handler functions.

name: metrics.ts
summary: Metrics collection for Edge Functions: MetricsCollector class with record, timing, increment, and flush methods; plus createMetrics factory.

name: tracing.ts
summary: Distributed tracing utilities for Edge Functions: trace context creation from request headers, child span creation, elapsed time calculation, and trace header propagation.

name: types.ts
summary: Central type definitions file exporting Database (Supabase generated types) and Json types used across Edge Functions.

name: worker.ts
summary: Background worker runtime primitives: worker registration, heartbeat, job claiming/completion/failure, heartbeat loop, and job processing orchestration.

name: cancel-booking/index.ts
summary: Edge Function handler for cancelling a booking. Authenticates user, validates authorization, checks booking state, invokes cancel RPC, and sends notifications.

name: create-payment-order/index.ts
summary: Edge Function for creating a Razorpay payment order. Authenticates, validates request, checks idempotency, creates order via Razorpay API, and records in database.

name: monitoring-health-check/index.ts
summary: Health check endpoint for monitoring systems. Returns operational status with database connectivity verification.

name: process-refund/index.ts
summary: Edge Function for processing payment refunds via Razorpay. Authenticates, validates request, calls Razorpay refund API, and records refund in database.

name: process-whatsapp-webhook/index.ts
summary: Webhook endpoint for incoming WhatsApp messages. Verifies HMAC signature, deduplicates via body hash, routes messages to the WhatsApp conversation engine.

name: reschedule-booking/index.ts
summary: Edge Function for rescheduling a booking to a new slot. Authenticates, validates transition, invokes reschedule RPC, and handles notifications.

name: run-background-worker/index.ts
summary: Background worker process that claims jobs from the queue and dispatches to type-specific processors: WhatsApp send, incoming WhatsApp, analytics refresh, notifications, and SLA computation.

name: run-cron-minute/index.ts
summary: Minute-level cron job: verifies cron secret, checks worker health, enqueues background work, and monitors system health.

name: run-cron-nightly/index.ts
summary: Nightly batch job orchestrator: runs settlement, cleanup, rollups, token carry-forward, and analytics refresh steps with timing and logging.

name: send-reminders/index.ts
summary: Sends WhatsApp appointment reminders to patients with upcoming appointments. Verifies cron secret and processes pending reminders via the job queue.

name: send-whatsapp-message/index.ts
summary: Sends WhatsApp message templates via Meta Cloud API. Builds template components with variables and handles delivery receipt webhook routing.

name: verify-payment/index.ts
summary: Webhook endpoint for Razorpay payment verification. Validates webhook HMAC signature and processes captured payments by updating booking status.

name: doctor_operations.test.ts
summary: Integration tests for the doctor-operations Edge Function, covering session open/close, consultation start/complete, return-to-waiting, absent, recall and emergency patient flows against the real local Supabase stack.

name: local_stack.test.ts
summary: Smoke test that bootstraps the local Supabase stack via Docker status check and creates a service-role Supabase client used by other integration tests.

name: queue_operations.test.ts
summary: Integration tests for queue-control actions (pause, resume, recall, skip, restore, mark absent) and alert-threshold emission, against the real local stack.

name: queue_runtime.test.ts
summary: Integration tests for queue runtime RPCs (claim, complete, skip, restore, recall, doctor delay, mark absent) with token-engine assertions on session state and queue runtime events.

name: refund_sync.test.ts
summary: Integration test for refund synchronization: seeds a captured payment order and exercises the process-refund Edge Function to verify ledger and booking state updates.

name: usage_retention.test.ts
summary: Integration tests verifying subscription usage counters (bookings, doctors, receptionists) and retention/cleanup job behavior against the real local stack.

name: whatsapp_conversational.test.ts
summary: End-to-end integration tests for the WhatsApp conversational engine, driving inbound messages through the full booking, reschedule, cancel, queue-lookup and handoff flows and verifying outgoing job_queue entries and booking state.

name: whatsapp_lifecycle.test.ts
summary: Integration tests covering the WhatsApp message lifecycle: enqueue via RPC, delivery, retry, and read state on whatsapp_messages table.

name: seed_constants.ts
summary: Shared test fixture exporting the SEED constant with stable hospital, doctor, and patient identifiers used across integration tests.

name: audit.ts
summary: Provides fire-and-forget audit event writing to the audit_logs table via write_audit_log RPC. Enforces that governance events never silently disappear by coercing non-UUID entity/actor references into data fields, reading PostgREST errors explicitly, and reporting failures to logger and metrics.

name: whatsapp_booking_flow.ts
summary: WhatsApp booking flow: patient identified, doctor selected, date validated, booking confirmed. State machine with steps: name, doctor, date, confirm. Delegates booking creation to the atomic create_booking RPC to avoid duplicating allocation, fee lookup, and availability logic.

name: whatsapp_cancel_flow.ts
summary: WhatsApp cancellation flow: finds the nearest cancellable booking for a phone, prompts for confirmation, cancels with optimistic status guard, and initiates a partial refund per the hospital cancellation policy.

name: whatsapp_conversation_engine.ts
summary: Central orchestrator for the WhatsApp-first patient experience. Consumes one inbound message, resolves intent via classifyIntent, manages hospital-scoped/phone-scoped conversation state via get_conversation_state/set_conversation_state RPCs, dispatches to flow modules, and enqueues reply jobs through enqueue_job. No LLM intent routing; deterministic keyword matching only.

name: whatsapp_handoff_flow.ts
summary: Human handoff flow: escalates a WhatsApp conversation to hospital staff when the patient asks, when intents repeatedly fail, or when a flow errors. Conversations must never get stuck. Exports WA_PATIENT_ACTOR constant used in WhatsApp audit attribution.

name: whatsapp_intent_router.ts
summary: Deterministic keyword-based intent classification for WhatsApp messages: book, queue_status, reschedule, cancel, yes, no, handoff, help, greeting, unknown. No LLM. Also exports date parsing (today, tomorrow, weekdays, dd/mm formats) and patient name / choice extraction.

name: whatsapp_queue_flow.ts
summary: Read-only WhatsApp queue status lookup: returns the patient's token, current live token, patients ahead, and estimated wait time. Sanitizes phone input to prevent PostgREST filter injection. Uses queue_sessions and doctor_schedules tables for live data.

name: whatsapp_reschedule_flow.ts
summary: WhatsApp reschedule flow: finds the nearest reschedulable booking, validates the new date, marks the old booking as rescheduled with an optimistic guard, and creates a new booking via the atomic create_booking RPC. Links new booking to the original via carry_forwarded_from.

name: 01_foundation.sql
summary: SETURA foundation migration: creates core enums (user_role_type, booking_status, booking_source), helper functions (set_updated_at, prevent_hospital_id_update), and core tables (hospitals, profiles, user_roles, patients, hospital_working_hours, hospital_holidays) with RLS policies. Establishes SECURITY DEFINER auth helpers (current_user_role, is_global_admin, user_has_hospital_access, user_has_hospital_role).

name: 02_atomic_token_engine_&_bookings.sql
summary: Atomic token engine and bookings: creates hospital_daily_counters table, generate_next_token() SECURITY DEFINER function, queue_sessions table, bookings table with full booking lifecycle, booking_events audit table. Includes handle_booking_status_change trigger, create_booking() and advance_queue() RPCs. Adds Realtime publication for bookings/booking_events/queue_sessions.

name: 03_doctorscheduling&slotengine.sql
summary: Doctor scheduling and slot engine: creates doctor_specializations, doctor_schedules (with btree_gist exclusion constraint for no-overlapping schedules), doctor_schedule_blocks, doctor_leaves (with daterange exclusion), override_type enum, and doctor_availability_overrides tables. Provides is_doctor_available(), get_remaining_token_capacity(), estimate_wait_minutes() SECURITY DEFINER functions.

name: 04_whatsapp_messaging_engine.sql
summary: WhatsApp messaging engine: creates whatsapp_message_status/direction/template_category enums, whatsapp_templates, whatsapp_conversations, whatsapp_messages, whatsapp_delivery_logs, and whatsapp_webhook_events tables. Provides find_or_create_whatsapp_conversation(), queue_whatsapp_message(), fetch_pending_whatsapp_messages(), handle_whatsapp_delivery_status(), schedule_whatsapp_retry(), register_webhook_event() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.

name: 05_notification_queue.sql
summary: Generic notification queue: creates notification_channel/status/priority enums, notification_templates, notification_queue, and notification_deliveries tables. Provides queue_notification(), fetch_pending_notifications(), mark_notification_sent(), schedule_notification_retry() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.

name: 06_background_job_queue.sql
summary: Background job queue: creates job_queue table with job type, payload, status, priority, retry fields. Provides claim_jobs(), complete_job(), fail_job(), get_pending_jobs() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs for worker coordination.

name: 07_settlement_engine.sql
summary: Settlement engine: creates payment_orders, payment_attempts, payment_ledger, refunds, and settlements tables with full financial audit trail. Provides create_payment_order(), record_payment_attempt(), settle_hospital_payments() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.

name: 08_analytics_engine.sql
summary: Analytics engine: creates analytics tables for tracking booking metrics, queue performance, doctor productivity, and patient flow statistics.

name: 09_abuse_protection_&_rate_limiting.sql
summary: Abuse protection and rate limiting: creates rate_limit_config, rate_limit_logs, and api_request_logs tables. Implements per-hospital, per-endpoint rate limiting with configurable thresholds and logging.

name: 10_audit_&_security_engine.sql
summary: Audit and security engine: creates audit_events table for immutable audit trail. Provides log_audit_event() and helper functions for tracking all significant system mutations.

name: 11_realtime_presence_schedule_tasks.sql
summary: Realtime, presence, and scheduled tasks: configures Supabase Realtime for live updates, adds presence tracking, and scheduled task infrastructure.

name: 12_hospital_configuration_engine.sql
summary: Hospital configuration engine: creates configuration tables for per-hospital settings, preferences, and operational parameters.

name: 13_payment_engine.sql
summary: Payment engine: integrates Razorpay with payment_orders table, payment_attempts tracking, webhook handling for payment status updates, and refund processing.

name: 14_dead_letter_queue.sql
summary: Dead letter queue: creates dead_letter_jobs table for capturing failed jobs that exceeded retry limits, with retention and analysis capabilities.

name: 15_partitioning_strategy.sql
summary: Table partitioning strategy: implements range partitioning on time-series tables (bookings, audit_events) for scalability.

name: 16_idempotency_hardening.sql
summary: Idempotency hardening: adds idempotency_key columns and unique constraints to key mutation tables. Ensures safe retry behavior for all financial operations.

name: 17_queue_monitoring_engine.sql
summary: Queue monitoring engine: creates queue_metrics, queue_health_checks, and SLA monitoring tables for real-time queue performance tracking.

name: 18_config_versioning_&_rollback.sql
summary: Configuration versioning and rollback: creates config_versions table and versioning RPCs for safe configuration changes with audit trail.

name: 19_background_worker_engine.sql
summary: Background worker engine v2: creates job_queue_v2, worker_registry, worker_leases, and worker_heartbeats tables. Provides claim_jobs_v2(), complete_job_v2(), register_worker(), send_worker_heartbeat() RPCs. Known regression: claim_jobs_v2 does not populate lease_expires_at.

name: 20_presence_engine.sql
summary: Presence engine: implements real-time presence tracking for active users, doctors, and queue participants.

name: 21_analytics_rollups.sql
summary: Analytics rollups: creates materialized views and rollup tables for pre-computed analytics metrics (hourly, daily, weekly aggregations).

name: 22_partition_automation.sql
summary: Partition automation: adds automatic partition creation and maintenance for high-volume time-series tables.

name: 23_retention_&_cleanup_engine.sql
summary: Data retention and cleanup: creates retention_policies table and cleanup RPCs for managing data lifecycle (soft deletes, archival, purging).

name: 24_operational-monitoring_engine.sql
summary: Operational monitoring engine: creates operational_metrics, system_health_checks, and alert_thresholds tables for system observability.

name: 25_api_idempotency_registry.sql
summary: API idempotency registry: creates idempotency_keys table for Edge Function-level idempotency with expiration.

name: 26_migration_metadata_&_registry.sql
summary: Migration metadata and registry: creates migration_history and schema_version tables for tracking applied migrations and rollback capabilities.

name: 27_role_permissions.sql
summary: Role permissions: refines role hierarchy and adds granular permission system for role-based access control.

name: 28_booking_enhancements.sql
summary: Booking enhancements: adds booking_fee_inr field, one-time backfill of booking fees. Known issue: booking_fee_inr has no runtime writer.

name: 29_cancellation_policy.sql
summary: Cancellation policy: creates cancellation_policies table and enforces cancellation rules with refund calculation logic.

name: 30_device_sessions.sql
summary: Device sessions: creates device_sessions table for tracking authenticated user devices, supports session management and device-level logout.

name: 31_doctor_leave_management.sql
summary: Doctor leave management: extends doctor_leaves table with approval workflow, leave type, and balance tracking.

name: 32_subscription_engine.sql
summary: Subscription engine: creates subscription_plans, hospital_subscriptions, and subscription_invoices tables for SaaS billing.

name: 33_settlement_engine_refactor.sql
summary: Settlement engine refactor: reorganizes settlement tables and RPCs for improved clarity and performance.

name: 34_payment_ledger_cleanup.sql
summary: Payment ledger cleanup: fixes data integrity issues in payment_ledger and ensures correct financial record state.

name: 35_hospital_config_enhancements.sql
summary: Hospital configuration enhancements: adds additional config fields and validation rules for hospital-level settings.

name: 36_audit_standardization.sql
summary: Audit standardization: standardizes audit event types, actor fields, and severity levels across the system.

name: 37_feature_flags.sql
summary: Feature flags: creates feature_flags table and is_feature_enabled() function for controlled feature rollouts.

name: 38_missing_rpc_functions.sql
summary: Missing RPC functions: backfills RPC functions that were referenced by code but not yet defined in migrations.

name: 39_schema_alignment.sql
summary: Schema alignment: aligns database schema with the generated TypeScript types, fixing drift between code and database.

name: 40_subscription_usage_engine.sql
summary: Subscription usage engine: creates usage_metrics and usage_limits tables for metered billing and quota enforcement.

name: 41_integration_hardening.sql
summary: Integration hardening: adds additional validation, security checks, and integrity constraints to integration tables.

name: 42_whatsapp_conversational_engine.sql
summary: WhatsApp conversational engine: creates conversation_state and handoff tables for stateful WhatsApp conversations with intent routing.

name: 43_queue_runtime.sql
summary: Queue runtime: the largest queue migration, implementing queue pause/resume, token skip/restore, doctor delay marking, recall, and emergency patient insertion as SQL RPCs.

name: 44_queue_runtime_flag.sql
summary: Queue runtime feature flag: small migration toggling queue_runtime feature flag for safe rollout.

name: 45_queue_operations.sql
summary: Queue operations: extends queue runtime with operations RPCs for batch processing, queue health evaluation, and admin notifications.

name: 46_doctor_clinical_operations.sql
summary: Doctor clinical operations: creates consultation_notes, prescriptions, and clinical_assessments tables. Provides clinical workflow RPCs for the doctor dashboard.

name: 47_enterprise_command_center.sql
summary: Enterprise command center: large migration creating executive dashboards, multi-hospital analytics, hospital comparison views, and command center RPCs.

name: 48_privilege_hardening.sql
summary: Privilege hardening: revokes PUBLIC grants on SECURITY DEFINER functions, establishes fail-closed privilege boundary. Known issue (F16-04): the PUBLIC grant is never revoked (only named-role grants are), and the supabase_admin grantor rows were silently skipped.

name: 49_phase_1_5_defect_fixes.sql
summary: Phase 1.5 defect fixes: migration applying targeted fixes for issues identified during Phase 1.5 verification. The four functions in this migration are safe only by accident - each is CREATE OR REPLACE of a pre-existing signature, preserving the prior ACL.
